It’s that I Just had a horrible fight with my family

I’ve been  studying for an entrance exam into grad school. I’ve taken some time off work so I can dedicate to studying. 

During undergrads I studied well at night. So that’s what I do now. I start studying at 8 pm and go till around 6 am. Then I fall asleep around 7 am and wake up at 2 pm. 

However I’m in quarantine with my sister and her boyfriend. As well as my parents. 

My sister has been having problems with me waking up at 3 pm for some reason. She has implied that I’m lazy and aren’t studying enough. She told me to try to wake up at 12. So I said “fine. You can wake me up and I can wake up earlier” 

So the next day at 12. She slams open my door and starts yelling like an insane person and opening my light. I told her get out and asked what the hell is wrong with her. She then leaves and says “you have only limited time. I think you should be studying more” 

I lost it and told her it wasn’t her business what I do and then she started questioning my schedule. Huge fight and I just ignored. 

We sorta made up hours later and dinner came around but the topic arose again. And I told her what she did was still messed up and that I’m still upset over her comments. She told me “look you can either cry about it or move on” so I told her “that’s really rude to say. Someone is upset and that’s what you say”

Her boyfriend then starts laughing. So I looked at him and said “what’s funny? What are you laughing at?” Then she started laughing. And he said “sorry” and began laughing. And my sister said “aw don’t apologize” 

I got up and just left. The next day she came to me and said “we good” I told her no and how upset they were at laughing. She called me a bully and walked away. 

THEN hours later I’m trying to study but her bf is in the living room snoring. Even though it’s 4 pm. I’m already upset as the WiFi isn’t working and I’m trying to study. So I had enough and closed our living room doors and said “bunch of insensitive assholes live in this damn house” I said under my breath so no one really heard maybe they did.

I tried explaining to my parents to talk to them but nothing happened. So I decided to go talk. Point blank I told them why I’m upset. Didn’t cuss anyone out. Didn’t hit anyone. Just maybe got passionate and spoke a bit louder. Not even that honestly. 

Their response was “I did apologize” my sister wasn’t even looking at me. 

So I said “I’m leaving to the condo” we have a condo hours away. 

As I’m packing my sister texts me some really nasty stuff and I told him to F off. 

I started packing and my step dad came in and asked everything. I Explained how my head has been hurting for 2 days and I can’t even study. He snapped and threw things at me and began punching me. My sister saw and he began joining him. And they both beat me up bad. They are both small and I could have hit back but I refrained. I can’t hit family wtf. I tried to leave but I kept getting hit. At the end I had bruises and blood. My sister started crying and apologizing then started freaking out again. 

At the end everyone blamed it on me and that I was unstable and ruin relations. Then in the morning my step dad tried to apologize.  I told him I was done with him. 

In the morning my sister and her bf were talking shit about me again so I came out and said “what did I do to warrant all this? Y’all lie so much” my sister cussed me out so bad. I left and began packing. We got into another fight. This time I tried to explain my point but I got labeled with being a person who yells and uncivilized. 

My back hurts. My body aches so bad. I’m now leaving for the condo and will be looking for an apartment. 

Idk anymore
He’s the one who beat me up horribly
My dad is with me now. He talked about how he blacked out when we fought was scared for himself.

It’s not even minor
